function key(color)
    local colors = {
        RED = "\27[31m",
        GREEN = "\27[32m",
        YELLOW = "\27[33m",
        BLUE = "\27[34m",
        MAGENTA = "\27[35m",
        CYAN = "\27[36m",
        LIGHT_GRAY = "\27[37m"
    }

    local c = colors[color] or "\27[37m"

    rconsoleprint("[")
    rconsoleprint(c .. "KEY" .. "\27[0m")
    rconsoleprint("]")
end

function info(color)
    rconsoleprint("[")
    rconsoleprint("\27[96m" .. "INFO" .. "\27[0m")
    rconsoleprint("]")
end

function getversion()
    local ver = readfile("version.txt")
    local t = {}

    for part in ver:gmatch("[^%.]+") do
        table.insert(t, part)
    end

    while #t < 3 do
        table.insert(t, "0")
    end

    return ("v%s.%s.%s"):format(t[1], t[2], t[3]):lower()
end
